headlines.title: Bank of America backs Pharvaris on breakthrough for rare swelling disease
headlines.summary: BofA sees the recent dip in PHVS’s share price as a buying chance ahead of two big FDA decisions in 2027.

headlines.title: Bank of America, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley Announce Landmark $63 Billion Financing Structure to Enable AI Compute Capacity in Partnership with Broadcom
headlines.summary: Bank of America (NYSE: BAC), Blackstone (NYSE: BX), Citi (NYSE: C) and Morgan Stanley (NYSE: MS) (the "Lead Financial Partners") today announced a $63 billion transaction to enable the deployment of AI compute capacity, leveraging Broadcom Inc.'s (NASDAQ: AVGO) technology, for Anthropic. This transaction is part of the strategic compute capacity agreement previously announced by Broadcom, with expected deliveries starting in calendar 2027.

headlines.title: Micron Climbs 4% as Bank of America Grows More Positive on Memory; Western Digital Rises 5%, SanDisk Gains 3%
headlines.summary: Bank of America just met with Micron executives and came away more positive on memory, pointing to a structural shift in how customers are locking in supply that could change the economics of one of the most volatile corners of the chip market.

headlines.title: BofA names top application software stocks heading into Q3 earnings
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Bank of America analysts highlighted three application software stocks they expect to deliver strong third-quarter results, emphasizing that selectivity has become critical in the sector as artificial intelligence and shifting budget priorities create separation between leaders and laggards.

headlines.title: Gen Z vs. Gen X in 2026: The Shocking Pay Gap Behind Job Switching
headlines.summary: Gen Z and Gen X workers face different pay realities. See how the wage gap could influence who stays put and who searches for a new job.

description: Bank of America Corporation, through its subsidiaries, provides various financial products and services for individual consumers, small and middle-market businesses, institutional investors, large corporations, and governments worldwide. It operates through four segments: Consumer Banking, Global Wealth & Investment Management (GWIM), Global Banking, and Global Markets. The Consumer Banking segment offers traditional and money market savings accounts, certificates of deposit and IRAs, checking accounts, and investment accounts and products; credit and debit cards; residential mortgages and home equity loans; and direct and indirect loans. The GWIM segment provides investment management, brokerage, banking, and trust and retirement products and services; wealth management solutions; and customized solutions, including specialty asset management services. The Global Banking segment offers lending products and services, including commercial loans, leases, commitment facilities, trade finance, and commercial real estate and asset-based lending; treasury solutions, and underwriting and advisory services. The Global Markets segment provides market-making, financing, securities clearing, settlement, and custody services; securities and derivative products; and risk management products using interest rate, equity, credit, currency and commodity derivatives, foreign exchange, fixed-income, and mortgage-related products. Bank of America Corporation was founded in 1784 and is based in Charlotte, North Carolina.
